findings.title: The Masses qualification changes cases to persons and unbecoming to excessive
findings.assessment: Both translations compare writing with repeated Masses, but earlier localizes the criticism in some cases while T4B localizes it in some persons and characterizes repetition as excessive. The Latin insolens in aliquibus ... phrase is damaged in the T4B OCR and allows unresolved scope. This is not a proven inversion or settled critique of particular people.
findings.next_action: Read the entire quoted conclusion, especially insolens, in aliquibus, and the repetition noun, before fixing the scope and adjective.
